# Encrypted icon interoperability

`web-vault-icon.json` was generated with the real `encryptPresentationAsset`
implementation in Palladin-io/palladin-react-web-panel, commit
`a0ac8e853f993d83d320f61ebc8d501a16a067dc` (2026-09-23), using a synthetic 1×1 PNG and an explicitly public test
key of 32 bytes with value 7. It contains no user data or production keys.

It pins the shared PLDNV2AS container version 1, protocol 2, suite 1, 84-byte
header, HKDF context and XChaCha20-Poly1305 AAD. Metadata revisions are not part
of immutable asset references or authenticated data.
